_note: Layer 3 of the task axis: O*NET's formal step -> the name insiders actually use. O*NET writes in government register ('Analyze data to identify trends or relationships among variables'); practitioners search for 'exploratory data analysis'. Each entry keeps the DWA id as its receipt, so every published tag can cite which occupational process step it came from and which occupations perform it. `onet` is evidence; `slug`/`label` are our naming judgement and are labelled as such wherever published. SOURCE: O*NET 30.3 Database, US Dept of Labor / Employment and Training Administration, CC BY 4.0.
_status: SAMPLE — 22 of ~500 relevant steps mapped, to agree the shape before the full pass.
